description: Lossless content-addressed raw evidence. Decompress objects using XZ (Python lzma or xz -dc); source_path reconstructs the retained original artifact filename. Identical data are stored once. Original bytes, not normalized JSON, determine object IDs.
scope: Linux prewarmed CPU damage calculation and repaint; no PTY, shaping, presentation or physical input latency.
source_audits: Three candidate runs audited by the documentation author; same-binary and rejected-specialization audits supplied independently by the raster benchmark reviewer. All preserved report statistics are recomputed from their raw records during export and verification.

exclusions: Executable and source tar bytes are omitted; their verified sizes/SHA256 are above.

The package includes all original timing report JSON and 120 raw process logs, full Cargo build JSONL/log/tree records, source manifests, font file hashes/query output, benchmark/injection and runner/workflow source.
All 240 reference-frame paths are preserved through deduplicated lossless objects, including both states of all six fixtures and both sides on both architectures.
Font file bytes were not retained in the original artifacts; recorded file hashes and actual reference pixels are preserved.
GitHub original artifacts have seven-day retention; this checked-in subset persists with the repository.
